CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.
   B. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
